light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: The same place as the first image — the very same room, same walls, same door, same furniture and shelves, same light — seen from a slightly different spot a little later. The presenter is the man of the reference photos — about 50, black curly hair, short greying beard, the face of the last input image — dressed in a worn olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, stained with paint and dust, and a worn brown leather apron over it. He stands on the back patio of the house, on red clay tiles in daylight, beside an old wooden garden bench with one loose armrest; behind him a whitewashed wall with potted plants, a plastic flower pot on the floor and a clothesline; he looks at the lens, one hand resting on the bench. Medium shot from the waist up, the scene fills the frame.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: his open hand gesturing toward the wet corner of the patio, looking at the lens. He still wears the same worn olive-green work shirt with rolled sleeves and the brown leather apron.

clips.text: La cola de caseína no es para la intemperie. Ni para lo que se moja seguido: el baño, la cocina junto al fregadero, el patio.
clips.action: he gestures around the patio with an open hand.

clips.text: Para exterior, compra una cola para exteriores, de las resistentes al agua, o una de poliuretano. Esa sí conviene.
clips.action: he counts on his fingers, talking frankly to the lens.

clips.text: Y tampoco es para cosas que cargan mucho peso sobre la cabeza de alguien. Ahí no se experimenta.
clips.action: he points up at the eaves of the patio roof and shakes his head.

clips.text: Ni para plástico, metal o vidrio. Es cola para madera, y de paso para papel, cartón y tela.
clips.action: he taps a plastic flower pot with a knuckle and shakes his head.

clips.text: Esta cola es para adentro: una silla floja, un cajón, un marco, una caja de madera, un juguete.
clips.action: he sits down sideways on the sound end of the bench and counts on his fingers.

clips.text: Y para eso, si la haces bien, aguanta lo mismo que una buena cola blanca, y te cuesta centavos.
clips.action: he taps the wooden seat of the bench beside him.

clips.text: Rosa, por cierto, me preguntó dónde tenía anotados los otros arreglos que hago con cosas de la casa.
clips.action: he takes the phone out again and looks at it with a smile.

clips.text: Y es lo que te decía antes: los tengo ordenados en la guía del canal, con materiales y medidas. El enlace está abajo.
clips.action: he pockets the phone and points down toward the lower corner of the frame.

clips.text: Bueno. Ya pasó la noche. Vamos a ver si la silla y las probetas aguantaron.
clips.action: he stands up from the bench and heads toward the back door of the house.
